title: Implementar runner CI mobile/touch para Habits configurables
mission: Implement a deterministic Playwright mobile/touch runner for the isolated configurable-Habits candidate so its existing mobile canary can run in CI. Emulate a representative touch viewport, exercise Calendar/Habits/Money mode switching and tracker controls, detect page-wide horizontal overflow/clipping/dead controls, and persist rendered evidence without changing product authority.
definition_of_done: Add a Playwright mobile/touch test for candidate/calendar-habits-custom-trackers-v1/index.html at a representative small viewport.
Exercise Calendar/Habits/Money switching and configurable tracker controls with touch input.
Assert no page-wide horizontal overflow, clipping, overlap, dead controls or unintended activation in the tested flows.
Verify Habits timeline/range navigation remains usable and Money/Calendar remain reachable.
Persist exact viewport/browser observations and screenshots or equivalent rendered artifacts through a bounded CI workflow.
Do not change Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or production pointers.
